reviews.t: Useful for Travel, but Too Many Shortcomings for Everyday
reviews.x: The Philips Norelco 8040X electric shaver is a compact, lightweight unit that can be used dry or wet.  In either case, it uses Nivea for Men shaving conditioner to smooth the razor over your face as you shave.  Ultimately, it is capable of delivering a good shave, but it has too many drawbacks to recommend for everyday use. I replaced it with this razor because it is the updated version of the advantage.  I thought it would perform the same as the advantage, but it doesn't.   It seems underpowered compared to the Advantage.  Although it feels comfortable when I shave, it refuses to finish the job.  No matter how often I go over the same area, it leaves alot of hair behind.  I am so f

reviews.t: Good Philips/Norelco quality but bad design
reviews.x: This is the third of Norelco's waterproof series that I have owned. The overall quality is just as good as previous models and other Philips/Norelco products. The shaver is constructed well and is lighter and more compact than previous models. Charging and battery life also seem to be very good.  The main problem I find with this new design is that the heads/razors are floating and not encased as previous models and most other shavers. When using this shaver in the shower this is not a problem.

reviews.t: Yikes, this thing is weak!
reviews.x: I like the design and feel of this shaver, but the motor is so weak that it takes forever to shave. I have to sit in the shower and shave for 20 minutes and I don't grow a big or strong beard. The 8 hour charge for 30 minute use just magnifies my frustration. This shaver might be great for getting rid of that preteen peach fuzz, but for most adults you can grow hair faster than this thing can cut it. How did this ever get past product testing, I don't know!

reviews.t: great shaver, high cost of consumable
reviews.x: I have had this one for a week now. Works great if you shave twice a day. Once a day is definitely not sufficient for me.  The moisturizing part makes it a great and smooth shave, but you have roughly 4-5 weeks worth of cream in a bottle. This leads to $3 a week in consumable. I did not have to recharge it in a week of use. It is fantastic to be able to shave in the shower.  This model has a travel lock, which is the only reason to purchase this one instead of the 8020X.

reviews.t: Solid Shaver
reviews.x: I used blades for 5 years, but I needed the convenience of an electric.  The 8040 does a solid job and has adequate power for a beard that grows in pretty fully on a daily basis.  I can't skip more than a day of shaving with it, though, or the long hairs just won't get cut.  It's comfortable enough to use every day, though, especially when used in the shower.  Great features for the money.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the shave quality and smoothness, especially the moisturizing conditioner that reduces irritation and razor burn.
Several reviewers complain the motor is weak or the shave is not close enough, requiring long shave times or frequent shaving.
Reviewers frequently mention the high ongoing cost of the Nivea shaving conditioner consumable.
Some reviewers criticize the design and accessories, such as the flimsy travel case and inconvenient sideburn trimmer.
Battery and charging performance receive mixed feedback, with some finding it good and others frustrated by long charge times for short use.
